This winter scene accompanies a summer landscape on view elsewhere in this gallery. When Van Goyen painted the two little pictures in 1625, he rested on a long tradition.

editorial.note: This sugar factory illustrates the great impact of Dutch colonialism on the industry, landscape, and population of Java. The originally wooded area was turned into an industrial site.

152483.title: Wooded Landscape with Merrymakers in a Cart
152483.creator: Meindert Hobbema

editorial.note: A lively party of travellers in a horse-drawn wagon passing farmhouses amid the trees. Figures along the side of the country road respond as they wave exuberantly.

152521.title: Portrait of a Surveyor (Andries van der Wal)
152521.creator: anonymous

editorial.note: Surveyor and architect Andries van der Wal, Northern Netherlands, 3rd quarter 17th century. Andries van der Wal was commissioned by the city of Haarlem in 1661 to submit designs for a northward extension to the city.

152523.title: Landscape with Fishermen and Farmers Extracting Peat in a Marsh
152523.creator: Hendrik Willem Schweickhardt

editorial.note: Here, peat –an important source of fuel –is being extracted from below the water table, a common technique in the west and north of the Netherlands.
